$comment: No utility-class colour layer — plain CSS, Sass, or a component library's own theming.
The point of this file is the null: with no utility classes to find, a grader that
silently used Tailwind patterns would report '0 raw colours' on a stylesheet full of them
and certify the pass. Scripts must print 'not measured' for a disabled knob, never 0.
Detection here leans on custom properties and @use/$-variables, which Sass and plain CSS
name: plain-css
